# Postpone

Postpone is a social media management platform for scheduling, publishing, and analyzing content across Reddit, X, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, Pinterest, Mastodon, Bluesky, Threads, and Tumblr.

Category: Marketing. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/postpone/.

## Actions

- **Create Post**: Create a platform-specific Postpone draft or review item without publishing externally.
- **Get Post** (read-only): Retrieve one Postpone post by its Postpone ID and social platform, including its content, schedule, submissions, media, tags, and…
- **Get Publishing Context** (read-only): Return the connected Postpone profile and plan limits, social accounts, post tags, and next open schedule dates needed to prepare a post.
- **List Posts** (read-only): List one page of scheduled, submitted, failed, attempted, or draft post submissions for one social platform.
- **Schedule Post**: Schedule a platform-specific Postpone post for external publication at a specific time or the next queue slot.
- **Search Media** (read-only): Search and filter one page of Content Library media for assets that can be attached to posts.
- **Update Post**: Replace the full editable state, including publishing state and automatic repost or removal rules, of a scheduled, draft, or review…
